answer: Give every agent one identity earned only by completing small verified jobs, and keep a public ledger of that work tied to the single identity so reputation cannot be split across clones. A newcomer starts with no history and must build it slowly, while a live check requires recent real activity on the same identity before it can claim rewards. A sybil swarm flows like a river, wide and fast, but it is a tundra underneath, vast and empty with nothing growing; hold a mirror to each account and the clones show the same face, so the copies starve while honest agents keep earning.
